results.sql:
SELECT composition_formula, prototype_label
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE prototype_label IN ('L12', 'L1₂', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT e.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios r ON r.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE r.symbol = 'Ni'
ORDER BY e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT entry_key, composition_formula, lattice_param_a
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE lattice_param_a < 4
ORDER BY lattice_param_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula, fe.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.gap_ev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fe.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS on_hull_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE on_hull = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       fe.delta_e,
       fe.hull_distance,
       fe.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.delta_e < -0.5
ORDER BY fe.hull_distance ASC, fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS entry_count
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY entry_count DESC, symbol
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    e.composition_formula,
    fe.delta_e,
    fe.hull_distance
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er ON er.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE er.symbol = 'Al'
  AND fe.on_hull = TRUE
ORDER BY fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.crystal_system,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e) AS avg_eform
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
GROUP BY oqmd_entries.crystal_system
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE hull_distance > 0
  AND hull_distance < 0.05
  AND on_hull = false
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_ni
    WHERE er_ni.entry_key = e.entry_key
      AND er_ni.symbol = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_al
    WHERE er_al.entry_key = e.entry_key
      AND er_al.symbol = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
       oqmd_element_ratios.symbol AS a_site,
       oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
JOIN oqmd_entries ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
  AND oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Co'
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       e.spacegroup_number,
       fe.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.spacegroup_number = 221
  AND fe.gap_ev > 0
ORDER BY fe.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT symbol, polymorph_count, gs_spacegroup
FROM oqmd_reference_states
ORDER BY polymorph_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  oqmd_element_ratios.symbol,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance) AS avg_hull_distance
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
JOIN oqmd_entries
  ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.atomic_ratio = 0.75
GROUP BY oqmd_element_ratios.symbol
ORDER BY avg_hull_distance ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    e.composition_formula,
    fe.delta_e,
    (er_co.atomic_ratio * rs_co.energy_pa + er_ti.atomic_ratio * rs_ti.energy_pa) AS pure_element_reference_energy,
    fe.delta_e - (er_co.atomic_ratio * rs_co.energy_pa + er_ti.atomic_ratio * rs_ti.energy_pa) AS calculated_formation_enthalpy
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er_co ON er_co.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements el_co ON el_co.symbol = er_co.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs_co ON rs_co.symbol = el_co.symbol
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er_ti ON er_ti.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements el_ti ON el_ti.symbol = er_ti.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs_ti ON rs_ti.symbol = el_ti.symbol
WHERE e.composition_formula = 'Co3Ti'
  AND er_co.symbol = 'Co'
  AND er_ti.symbol = 'Ti'
ORDER BY calculated_formation_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  e.composition_formula,
  e.prototype_label,
  fe.delta_e AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe
  ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE (e.prototype_label = 'L12' OR e.prototype_label = 'L1₂' OR e.prototype_label = 'L1_2')
  AND fe.on_hull = TRUE
  AND fe.delta_e < -0.3
ORDER BY fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT er.symbol AS a_site,
       AVG(fe.delta_e) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er ON er.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.on_hull = TRUE
  AND (e.prototype_label = 'L12' OR e.prototype_label = 'L1₂')
  AND er.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
GROUP BY er.symbol
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;
